alerts.title: 2 Czech Republic residents killed in crash near Pinedale
alerts.summary: The Wyoming Highway Patrol reported that two people died and two were injured in a collision on US 191 near milepost 123.5. The report said road and weather conditions were dry and clear; driver fatigue is being investigated.

alerts.title: Wyoming High School Football Week 5 Scoreboard for October 2-3, 2026
alerts.summary: No. 1 Star Valley edged No. 2 Cody 28–27 in overtime after tying the game with 22 seconds left; Thunder Basin also upset rival Campbell County 15–14. WyoPreps has scores from games across the state.

alerts.title: Unseasonable Heat, Fire Weather Risks Ahead For Cheyenne This Week
alerts.summary: A Cap City News forecast says southeast Wyoming could see highs near 90°F, very low humidity and little precipitation early in the week, raising fire-weather concerns around the Laramie Range.

alerts.title: Voters to decide on 2% lodging tax in upcoming general election
alerts.summary: Natrona County voters will decide whether to continue the visitor-paid lodging tax. Visit Casper says the revenue supports tourism promotion, events, and local visitor services.

alerts.title: Natrona County to consider lifting burn ban, hearing two zoning requests Tuesday
alerts.summary: County commissioners scheduled a hearing on a proposed burn-ban lift and two land-use requests for Oct. 6. Fire officials still advise residents to follow permit rules and avoid burning in high winds.

alerts.title: Wyoming Supreme Court concludes crossover-voting ban is constitutional
alerts.summary: The unanimous ruling upholds the state's 96-day party-affiliation freeze before primary elections, clearing the way for the rule to remain in place for November's general election.

alerts.title: The arguments for and against ‘The People’s Initiative’ on the Wyoming ballot
alerts.summary: Wyoming voters will decide on a proposed 50% property-tax cut for primary residences. Supporters and opponents debate the effects on household bills and local services.

alerts.title: Wyoming lawmakers could pursue some of the nation’s strictest limits on Flock-like cameras
alerts.summary: A legislative committee discussed draft restrictions on automatic license-plate readers, including short data retention and limits on sharing. The preliminary bill is expected to change before the next session.

alerts.title: Judge denies qualified immunity to Wyoming Boys’ School staff in abuse lawsuit
alerts.summary: A federal judge allowed some civil-rights claims involving isolation and use of force at the state-run facility near Worland to proceed to trial. The ruling concerns one of six lawsuits.

alerts.title: Analysis: 99% of commenters oppose motorized use changes in forests
alerts.summary: More than 134,000 comments were submitted on possible changes to national-forest travel rules; an analysis found that more than 99% opposed the changes in some way.

alerts.title: WYDOT closes Belt Loop in Rock Springs through Oct. 6
alerts.summary: SweetwaterNOW reported that the Belt Loop from Dewar Drive to Blair Avenue would be closed through Oct. 6 for concrete-joint sealing on WYO 376. Local access to West Center Street was expected to remain open.

alerts.title: Fremont County avoids EMT strike after extending contract
alerts.summary: A two-year contract extension averted a planned strike by EMTs and paramedics serving Fremont County while local governments work on a longer-term ambulance-service plan.

alerts.title: Torrington To Decide Whether To Have Residents Pay $800,000 Electricity Spike
alerts.summary: Torrington officials say transmission charges pushed the city’s wholesale energy bill up 189% year over year, adding about $800,000 annually. The council is weighing a ratepayer increase against using reserve funds.

alerts.title: Rawlins Man, Six Others, Get Prison After Bust Of Major Wyoming Drug Ring
alerts.summary: Seven members of a multi-county drug ring, including a Rawlins man identified as its leader, received prison sentences ranging from eight to 18 years. Thirty others were prosecuted at the state level.

alerts.title: A New Suicide Fatality Review Sheds Light On Prevention Efforts In Laramie County
alerts.summary: A new county review identifies social isolation and relationship or family stress among common risk factors, and calls for better coordination among crisis responders and health providers. It also highlights firearm-safe-storage outreach.

alerts.title: Casper Family Enlists 12-Foot Skeleton To Help Drivers Stop
alerts.summary: A Casper family put a 12-foot Halloween skeleton, nicknamed Tomb Petty, beside a neighborhood stop sign after hearing drivers race through the intersection near Dean Morgan Middle School.

alerts.title: MLB Drops Plan For Baseball In Grand Teton National Park After Public Backlash
alerts.summary: The baseball commissioner told Jackson-area officials that MLB will stop evaluating Grand Teton National Park as a possible game site after residents, conservationists and local leaders objected.

alerts.title: Feds: Man Accused Of Trafficking 174 Pounds Of Meth Tried To Eat Drugs During Chase
alerts.summary: Federal agents allege a Casper man suspected of trafficking meth and fentanyl led them on an I-25 chase and tried to eat drugs as they closed in. The charges remain allegations unless proven in court.

alerts.title: WYDOT’s Safe Pass Enforcement Begins With New WY22 Signage
alerts.summary: The WY22 Safe Pass program is now enforceable on Teton Pass. RVs, vehicles towing trailers and vehicles rated at 10,000 pounds or more must complete the online self-certification before driving the pass.

alerts.title: Mysterious Liberty Bell Appears Outside Campbell County Courthouse
alerts.summary: A bell that seemed bronze appeared on an empty courthouse pedestal in Gillette, puzzling staff for days. It turned out to be a papier-mâché America 250 gift made by local volunteers.

alerts.title: Data Center Critics Angry As Cheyenne Council OKs Another Data Center Annexation
alerts.summary: After a contentious six-hour meeting, the City Council approved a 1,260-acre annexation and rezoning for another data-center project. Residents raised concerns about the pace of growth, water, traffic and community impact.

alerts.title: Bucking the wind: Wyoming artists transform wind blade into snowfence
alerts.summary: A Wyoming art project near Esterbrook repurposes a retired turbine blade as a snow fence. WYDOT will monitor how well the installation limits drifting near a road.

alerts.title: 80 Trail Miles, 700 Downed Trees: Wyoming Forest Corps Tackles Maintenance Backlog
alerts.summary: A four-person crew with Friends of the Bridger-Teton cleared about 700 downed trees from 80 miles of trail this season, helping reopen routes across the national forest.
